Summary: 
Join an organisation that is shaping the future direction of software engineering in Australia, in an academic role that combines high-quality research, excellent teaching, and meaningful contribution to the School’s strategic priorities.

Job Details
•	Salary, 
o	Lecturer (Level B) – AUD $127,947 to $150,830 per annum + 17% superannuation
o	Senior Lecturer (Level C) – AUD $155,403 to $178,290 per annum + 17% superannuation
•	Full-time
•	2-Year Convertible Tenure Track or continuing appointment
•	Location: Kensington – Sydney, Australia

The Opportunity
Join the School of Computer Science and Engineering in the Faculty of Engineering at UNSW as a Lecturer / Senior Lecturer in a Teaching and Research role. In this role, you will contribute to the advancement of research and education in modern computing systems, while helping to shape the next generation of computing professionals.

You will conduct research in areas including AI for Software Engineering, Software Engineering for AI, AI Application Engineering, Software Development Lifecycle and Software Architectures. Through your research, you will contribute to high-impact scholarly outcomes, collaborative research initiatives and the School's growing international reputation in Software Engineering.

With established strengths across Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity and Computer Systems, UNSW offers an exceptional environment for academics seeking to build their research profile, contribute to interdisciplinary collaboration and deliver outstanding teaching. This is an opportunity to join one of Australia's leading Computer Science and Engineering schools, supported by world-class facilities, strong industry partnerships and a culture of innovation and impact.

This is an opportunity to join a global leader in Computer Science, with cutting-edge facilities, world-class faculty, and an innovative research environment. With strong industry partnerships and a commitment to sustainability, UNSW provides excellent opportunities for career development, collaboration, and impact.

About You
You are an emerging or established academic with expertise in Software Engineering and a passion for both research and teaching. You will have the ability to contribute to high-quality research outcomes while delivering engaging and innovative learning experiences for undergraduate and postgraduate students.

At Lecturer level (Level B), you will be developing your research profile and contributing to collaborative research activities, including competitive grant applications and scholarly publications, while also delivering high-quality teaching and supporting student learning across undergraduate and postgraduate courses.

At Senior Lecturer level (Level C), you will demonstrate an established research track record with evidence of research leadership, success in securing competitive funding, supervising HDR students, and making significant independent contributions to your field. You will also contribute to educational leadership through high-quality teaching, curriculum development, and mentoring students and colleagues.

You are an engaging educator with experience in delivering high-quality teaching and contributing to curriculum development. You are collaborative, adaptable, and motivated to contribute to a high-performing academic environment and to build strong relationships across academia and industry.

About UNSW
UNSW is a world leading institution recognised for its scale, prestige, and impact. With strong industry engagement and partnerships across sectors, UNSW provides a unique environment where academic expertise translates into real world outcomes. The university is home to cutting edge research that drives innovation and societal progress, while its excellence in teaching ensures students are prepared to lead in their fields. For academics, UNSW offers an outstanding platform to flourish — combining world class facilities, collaborative networks, and a culture of innovation that supports both career growth and meaningful contributions to the wider community.

The School of Computer Science and Engineering is one of the largest and most prestigious schools of computing in Australia. It offers undergraduate programmes in Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, and Bioinformatics, as well as a number of combined degrees with other disciplines. Our research and teaching staff are world leading and world building as they advance knowledge and learning. For more information on our school, please visit: https://www.unsw.edu.au/engineering/our-schools/computer-science-and-engineering 

Skills & Experience:
Lecturer (Level B)
•	A PhD in a related discipline, and/or relevant work experience.
•	Proven commitment to proactively keeping up to date with discipline knowledge and developments.
•	Demonstrated experience in teaching and learning design, development and delivery at undergraduate and/or postgraduate level.
•	Experience using and/or designing with educational technologies and online delivery methods.
•	Evidence of teaching effectiveness and passion for educational excellence (e.g. relevant discipline-based curriculum design and development at a variety of levels and scales).
•	Demonstrated knowledge of industry or experience of work-integrated learning (desirable). 
•	Evidence of ability to support and inspire students from diverse backgrounds and support student equity, diversity and inclusion initiatives.

Senior Lecturer (Level C)
•	A PhD in a related discipline, and/or relevant work experience.
•	Proven commitment to proactively keeping up to date with discipline knowledge and developments.
•	Demonstrated experience in teaching and learning design using a range of pedagogical approaches, development and delivery of courses and programs, at undergraduate and/or postgraduate level. 
•	Experience of implementing educational technologies and online delivery methods.
•	Evidence of teaching effectiveness and passion for educational excellence and fostering this in others.
•	Demonstrated success in initiating curriculum development and improvement. 
•	Demonstrated experience with industry or work-integrated learning. 
•	Evidence of ability to support and inspire students from diverse backgrounds and support student equity diversity and inclusion initiatives.
•	Demonstrated track record in research with outcomes of high quality and high impact with clear evidence of the desire and ability to continually achieve research excellence as well as the capacity for research leadership.
•	Experience in successfully recruiting and supervising high calibre students.
•	Demonstrated ability to work in a team, collaborate across disciplines and build effective relationships.
•	Evidence of highly developed interpersonal and organisational skills.
•	Demonstrated ability to interact with the profession and industry and attract funding for learning and teaching initiatives.
•	An understanding of and commitment to UNSW’s aims, objectives and values in action, together with relevant policies and guidelines.
•	Knowledge of health and safety responsibilities and commitment to attending relevant health and safety training.

Additional details about the specific responsibilities for this position can be found in the position description. This is available via JOBS@UNSW. 

To Apply: 
If you are an emerging academic looking to build your research and teaching profile, or an established academic seeking to further your career, this opportunity offers the chance to contribute to high-quality research, deliver engaging teaching, and help shape the future direction of the School. We encourage you to click the “Apply Now” button and submit your CV, cover letter, and responses addressing the Skills and Experience criteria.

If this opportunity interests you, but your experience does not align perfectly with every selection criterion, we still encourage you to apply.

Trading under Publicis Communications Australia
Role: Technical Lead
Location: Sydney

Who we are

Consumer habits are anything but linear, and attention must be earned. At Digitas, we understand that, to break through, brands must be surprising, entertaining and authentic. 

Driven by imagination and fueled by deep cultural, consumer and business insights, we craft impactful creative experiences across every medium — from integrated campaigns, gaming, and physical experiences to full-length feature films. 

We earn the right for brands to be part of their customers’ networks. We drive growth with our amazing clients, through our capabilities in Consulting, Products & Platforms, Customer Engagement and Digital Media.

Part of Publicis Groupe, and a Leader in Gartner’s Magic Quadrant for Global Marketing Agencies, we’re proud to work with some of the world’s leading brands.

Digitas – The Networked Experience Agency


The role:

The purpose of this role is to lead the technical design and delivery of impactful customer engagement solutions using the Braze platform, focused on a single, high-profile client with room to grow across the agency. As the Technical Lead, you will translate creative ideas into actionable Braze and data solutions, ensuring seamless execution. You will collaborate with stakeholders, develop prototypes, mentor technical teams, and maintain high standards for performance, documentation, and innovation.

This role focuses on 2 core areas:
1.	Technical leadership and solution design 
2.	Stakeholder collaboration and team development

 
Day to day you’ll get:

•	Work cross-functionally with the client and our account, creative, strategy and analytics teams to translate creative ideas into technical and data requirements for the Braze platform. Your vision will ensure client success from idea to implementation. 
•	Scope/build rapid prototypes which help us to respond to client briefs and assess technical viability.
•	Be the main point of contact when it comes to data requirements for Braze. Liaise with internal and external teams to ensure that we are leveraging client data securely, effectively and efficiently.
Ensure that all solutions are endorsed and supported by our client’s global and local technology teams and that all established standards are adhered to.
•	Be the absolute subject matter expert for our internal team and clients when it comes to the Braze platform 
•	Advise and mentor a local/offshore technical delivery team, fostering growth, capability and process.  
•	Work with the Digitas tech team to troubleshoot, test, and optimize solutions to achieve maximum performance with minimal errors.
Ensure continuity for the account by establishing and maintaining standards across the tech team for documentation and knowledge exchange.

Skills:
•	Expert level on-tool skills with one of the major customer engagement platforms (Salesforce, Adobe, Braze) 
•	Candidates with Braze experience are preferred. 
•	Salesforce, Braze or other certifications are a plus but not required
•	Ability to quickly learn new systems and processes.
•	Strong working knowledge of modern marketing data tools and integration patterns with an emphasis on how to solution data for targeting, personalisation and reporting 
•	Working knowledge of CDPs such as Segment, Tealium and mParticle. mParticle experience is a huge plus 
•	Analytical thinking, asking the right questions and challenging for better outcomes  
•	Strategic thinker, pushing the boundaries and always challenging us to think bigger or differently
•	Excellent collaboration, written and verbal communication skills

The person we are looking for has:

•	7+ years of experience working on the technical side of Martech, marketing automation or customer engagement roles
•	Background in prototyping and light coding. Minimally you should be strong in basic web languages (HTML, CSS, JS) and scripting languages such as Liquid or ActionScript. 
•	2+ years of experience articulating solution designs with Martech platforms
•	Proven track record of successful solution design work 
•	Experience working with complex data environments which depend on streaming data 
•	Experience managing and mentoring technical delivery teams
•	Bonus points for prior agency/consultancy experience, as well as working with/leading off-shore delivery teams

Got what it takes? We’d love to hear from you.

Our offer to you:

Be a part of the Publicis Groupe family, one of the world’s most progressive and dynamic modern communications businesses enjoying all the perks that come with our network offering:
•	Work with a diverse team where we value all the benefits of harnessing differences for our people, our clients and our business.
•	A committed Diversity Inclusion and Belonging strategy are driven through our Viva! Women, Tahi Katoa, Wholeself and Égalité programs
•	A creative, fun and rewarding office environment backed up by our Publicis Liberté flexibility approach
•	Access to employee benefits including – wellness programmes, learning and development opportunities, and network events
•	Day off on your birthday.

If you don’t tick every box in this ad, please don’t rule yourself out.  We focus on hiring people who share our values of inclusion, collaboration, adaptability, fearlessness, and integrity, rather than ticking boxes – so if this role resonates with you, please apply.

Diversity. Inclusion. Equity. More than just words, these are part of our DNA. 

At Publicis Groupe we are committed to the inclusion and recognition of all people; regardless of race, age, culture, ability, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status and religious affiliation. We believe that to deliver the best solutions to our clients, our people need to reflect the diverse communities in which our clients operate in. We value diversity and the skills, knowledge and experience that difference brings to our culture and solutions. 

Uniqueness is powerful; without it we wouldn’t be where we are today. So be you – we like it that way. 

We are committed to providing reasonable adjustments for people with disability or those that require additional support throughout the application process.  

Salary: Over threshold

Next Gen Talent
Company: Dharma Bhakti Group Pty Ltd t/a Sunrise Custom Homes
Position Title: Architectural Draftsperson
Location: Adelaide, South Australia, 3061
Salary: AUD 79,500 to 82,000 + Super

About the Business:
Sunrise Custom Homes are Adelaide’s trusted custom home builders. They specialise in fully customisable homes and work closely with each client to bring their vision to life. Whether you’re building your first home or creating an investment property, their expertise and passion ensure your dream becomes a reality.

About the Role:
They are seeking a skilled and motivated Architectural Draftsperson to join their team. This hands-on position requires strong technical capability in drafting and documentation, along with a commitment to accuracy and high-quality design outcomes. The ideal candidate will be proficient in industry-standard drafting software and confident in reading, interpreting, and producing detailed architectural drawings. You’ll play a key role in transforming concepts into build-ready documentation, contributing directly to the delivery of custom homes.

Minimum Requirements:
Diploma or Advanced Diploma in Building Design, Architectural Drafting, Building Design Technology or a related discipline, or an equivalent qualification.
Minimum 1–3 years' experience in architectural drafting or building design within Australian residential construction projects.

Key Responsibilities:
Prepare detailed architectural drawings, construction documentation and working drawings for residential dwellings, custom homes, renovations and property development projects using CAD and Revit software.
Develop concept drawings, floor plans, elevations, sections and detailed construction documentation based on client requirements, architectural designs and engineering specifications.
Produce accurate working drawings in accordance with the National Construction Code (NCC), relevant Australian Standards and local council planning requirements.
Prepare detailed documentation including structural layouts, site plans, floor plans, roof plans, drainage layouts, service layouts and construction details for residential projects.
Modify and customise existing home designs and floor plans to suit client preferences, site conditions, budget requirements and regulatory requirements.
Coordinate drawings and documentation with architects, engineers, building designers, surveyors, certifiers, energy assessors, consultants, builders and project managers to ensure design accuracy and project consistency.
Liaise with clients and project stakeholders to gather project information and translate design concepts into accurate technical drawings.
Prepare documentation required for Development Applications (DA), Planning Approvals, Building Approvals, Council submissions and other statutory approval processes.
Review architectural, structural and engineering drawings to identify inconsistencies, drafting errors and construction issues prior to project commencement.
Amend, revise and update drawings based on client feedback, council requirements, consultant recommendations, engineering input and design changes throughout the design and construction process.
Assist with project coordination, planning approvals and construction documentation throughout all stages of residential projects.
Prepare schedules for doors, windows, finishes, fixtures and fittings to support construction documentation and procurement.
Assist in preparing material quantities, preliminary cost estimates and design documentation for tendering and project planning purposes.
Conduct site measurements and inspections where required to verify existing conditions and ensure drafting accuracy for renovations, custom homes and development projects.
Collaborate with construction supervisors, site teams and project managers to resolve design-related queries during construction and issue updated documentation where required.
Maintain accurate electronic records of drawings, revisions, project documentation and version control using the company's document management systems.
Research and apply current building regulations, planning policies, residential construction methods and sustainable design principles to ensure ongoing compliance and improve project outcomes.

Essential Skills
Proficient in CAD and Revit software for producing accurate architectural drawings and construction documentation.
Strong understanding of residential construction methods, detailing, building systems and construction processes.
Thorough knowledge of the National Construction Code (NCC), Australian Standards and local council planning requirements.
Ability to interpret architectural drawings, engineering plans, technical specifications and consultant documentation.
Strong attention to detail with the ability to prepare accurate, compliant and high-quality documentation.
Excellent communication and coordination skills with the ability to work effectively with clients, engineers, consultants, builders, site teams and project managers.
Strong organisational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

result.description:
Randstad is proud to partner with Queensland Rail (QR) on a major recruitment drive to source engineering professionals. As part of this major recruitment drive, we are looking to identify an experienced Principal Telecommunications Network Engineer - ETCS for the ETCS Sequence Alliance (Embedded) division.  
  QR has a current project pipeline of over A$15 billion, and this is expected to grow exponentially in the build-up to the 2032 Brisbane Olympic and Paralympic Games.. As a result of this significant investment, the need to secure in-house technical and engineering resources is paramount to support their critical technology rollouts. This includes ensuring that European Train Control Systems (ETCS) telecommunications networks are technically robust and compliant across the network.  
  What You'll Do  
  The Principal Telecommunications Network Engineer - ETCS will provide specialist engineering services and technical leadership to project-based teams. You will be responsible for ensuring that ETCS telecommunications networks are technically robust, commercially optimized, and seamlessly integrated.  
 
  Drive Engineering Excellence  : Monitor and influence ETCS Cross River Rail (CRR) telecommunications data system projects, ensuring peak performance levels are achieved at competitive costs. You will ensure that integration into the QR data network never compromises reliability, availability, or maintainability.  
  Coach & Inspire:   Lead the facilitation of technical training and competency development for telecommunications office and field staff, ensuring a powerful capability uplift and compliance across teams.  
  Innovate & Optimize  : Ensure technical standards and procedures are meticulously documented and applied in accordance with Queensland Rail Quality Assurance and Improvement Principles.  
  Thought Leader  : Provide strategic technical leadership and advice to business groups, technical staff, and external stakeholders, ensuring complex network solutions align perfectly with QR's operational requirements.  
   Uphold Integrity : Champion strict compliance with professional engineering practices, Queensland Rail standards, and all corporate legal and safety obligations.  
 
  What We Are Looking For  
  We are looking for a strong implementor in the network engineering space who brings a deep understanding of data communications, commercial acumen, and high-level stakeholder management skills.  
 
  Qualifications  : A Bachelor of Engineering (Electrical & Electronic)   AND   ideally   current Registered Professional Engineer Queensland (RPEQ) status   or   have the necessary qualifications and experience to attain it. IE: have CEng or Professional Engineer status with Engineers Australia.  
  Network Telecoms Experience:   Extensive knowledge of LAN/WAN data communications, and physical network security applicable to a railway network. You must bring high-level skills in the design, system configuration, construction, auditing, commissioning, integration, and technical support of telecommunications network systems. Candidates would ideally come from a client or contractor background and have strong implementation experience.  
  Analytical & Technical Depth:   Extensive knowledge of telecommunications performance and integration principles, combined with strong analytical and problem-solving skills to keep ETCS CRR projects operationally effective.  
  Commercial Acumen:   A proven track record of delivering business-focused technical and professional network solutions that bring tangible commercial value to the business.  
  Soft Skills & Influence  : High levels of interpersonal, influencing, and negotiation skills.  
 
  Queensland Rail is a progressive organisation that promotes a flexible working environment to allow for a healthy work-life balance. It actively prioritizes the development of its people in a supportive, diverse, and inclusive work culture.  
  QR offers the following benefits:  
 
  Competitive remuneration packages  
  Comprehensive relocation assistance (if applicable)  
  A long-term consistent pipeline of work, offering job security and stellar opportunities for technical and professional development  
 
  Why choose Queensland to live and work?  
  More people from within Australia are migrating to Queensland than to any other state! It's hard not to see why, with a fantastic climate, affordable housing, stunning beaches, national parks, and one of the great wonders of the world - The Great Barrier Reef, Queensland has it all.  
  How to apply  
  If you want to grasp this life changing opportunity then please click apply.   For more information visit our landing page www.randstad.com.au/rail-australia/  

 At Randstad, we are passionate about providing equal employment opportunities and embracing diversity to the benefit of all. We actively encourage applications from any background. 
   
    Please  click here  to apply.
